args.body: For INVOICE-DEMO-REFERRAL-FIT, use workflow-evidence.json and the queued live invoice homepage if committed. Verify the relevant passages in the saved originals. If the EXEC did not receive the new homepage as input, use the committed capture and FETCH receipt directly. Use the existing one-policy-page allowance to resolve the strongest remaining terms question if needed. Advance to one private bilingual placement packet only if Books coverage, referral trigger, Canadian payout and permitted placement are supported. Keep the CSV demo’s observed scope distinct from Zoho import validation. If a material condition remains unresolved after the allowed check, save and read back the bounded verdict and close with a lesson under the actual lease. Reuse any completed verdict. No signup, tracking, spending or publication.
